query_normalized: investigating correlations between molecular descriptors and drug-likeness scores chemistry
rationale: This paper directly addresses the user's question by investigating the relationship between molecular descriptors and a key aspect of drug-likeness (bioactivity) using QSAR modeling, which satisfies criterion (a) for measuring the same biological/chemical mechanism and criterion (b) for analyzing the specific independent (descriptors) and dependent (bioactivity/drug-likeness) variables in the same domain.
